cases.setup: Set up a 40 x 30 m (44 x 33 yd) field. Play 6v6, with the attacking team having an extra player. Play begins with a pass from the coach to the attacking team. Mark an escape line across the pitch for each team to attack. Every time a team loses the ball, count to five out loud.
rules: Use the numerical advantage to press effectively.
Whoever wins the ball attacks immediately. If the attack stalls or the ball is lost, the other team does the same. Play does not stop.
When the ball changes hands, the next action goes straight away. No reset, no stoppage.
Defenders can shield the ball, block the space, or use their body to push attackers where they want them.
Win the ball back quickly after losing it. If you do not, the other team plays on from there.
cases.scoring: Earn a point if your team wins the ball back before you reach five. Count to five out loud as soon as your team loses the ball. Points are worth more when you score them where you have the extra numbers.

cases.intent: Delay the Attack.
cases.setup: Set up a 40 x 30 m (44 x 33 yd) area with wide channels on each side. Play 6v6. Play starts with a pass from a coach to one team, and restarts from the coach after a score or ball out. Mark an escape line across the pitch for each team to attack. Every time a team loses the ball, count to five out loud.
rules: Use the wide channels to create overloads.
If possession changes, immediately counter-press to regain control.
Whoever wins the ball attacks immediately. If the attack stalls or the ball is lost, the other team does the same. Play does not stop.
Defenders can shield the ball, block the space, or use their body to push attackers where they want them.
A regain only counts if your team plays forward with the next action. Win it and give it straight back and it does not count.
cases.scoring: Earn a point if your team wins the ball back before you reach five. Count to five out loud as soon as your team loses the ball. Points are worth most through the middle, then wide, then deep.
